text:
As of 2019, about 8.4% of the world population lived in extreme poverty, on less than $1.90 a day (2011 PPP), based on World Bank estimates for the pre-COVID year. Published series put the rate near 10% around 2015 and near 8.4% in 2019, so 8.4% is the figure for the year asked.
